name: node-red-contrib-webiq
description: Node-RED nodes for WebIQ API integration.

scripts.test: node --test test/local-smoke.test.js test/heartbeat.test.js test/typed-input.test.js test/tls.test.js test/fail-closed.test.js test/release-gaps.test.js test/node-red-runtime.test.js
